title: Reassigned to Kilo control and never team leader again

tellings.quote: never went back to no Wimer control they sent me to kilo control

plain: Mario Woods was a guard at nuclear missile sites near Ellsworth in South Dakota, and he says he was abducted by a UFO there in 1977. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that afterward he never went back to his old control post. He says he was sent to a different one called Kilo control and was never made team leader again, which he presents as a result of what happened.
